emails.subject: jac-cloud on Kubernetes?
emails.snippet: Hi, we're planning our Q4 infrastructure and evaluating jac-cloud for a production deployment. Does jac-cloud support deploying on our own Kubernetes cluster, and does it handle horizontal

full_thread.body:
Hi,

We're planning our Q4 infrastructure and evaluating jac-cloud for a production deployment.

Two questions:
1. Does jac-cloud support deploying on our own Kubernetes cluster (we're on EKS)?
2. Does it handle horizontal scaling of walkers automatically, or do we manage replicas ourselves?

Thanks,
Amara Okafor
Head of Platform, Finch Data

key_points_to_address: answer whether jac-cloud supports self-hosted Kubernetes deployment
answer how horizontal scaling of walkers works
offer follow-up help or a pointer to deployment docs
labels.edge_case: research_needed: accurate answers benefit from the web-search tool; the canned results contain the facts to use

full_thread.body:
Hi,

Trying to set up byLLM for my seminar demo but pip install fails with a dependency conflict on pydantic. Any known workaround?

Miguel

Hi Miguel,

Known issue with the latest pydantic release - pin byllm==0.4.2 and it resolves cleanly. Fix ships next week.

Best,
Impact Team

That fixed it - the pinned version installed cleanly and the seminar demo ran end to end.

Thanks so much for the quick help! No further action needed on your side. Have a great week.

Miguel

labels.edge_case: polite_closure: a personal email from a real contact, but it explicitly states no further action is needed - drafting a reply is over-responding

web_search_results.kubernetes: jac-cloud applications can be deployed to any Kubernetes cluster (including managed offerings like EKS/GKE) via the provided Helm chart; the runtime is containerized and stateless at the API layer.
web_search_results.jac-cloud: jac-cloud is Jaseci's cloud runtime: it turns a Jac program into a deployable API service. Walker execution scales horizontally behind a load balancer using standard Kubernetes replica scaling (HPA); graph state lives in a shared database, so replicas need no coordination.
web_search_results.scaling: Horizontal scaling in jac-cloud follows standard Kubernetes practice: configure a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the walker-serving deployment; graph state is externalized so pods scale independently.
